g.text: Left: a 0.1 cut-off removes most of the t-test's false flags (small biases made 'significant'), but its ranges still miss the truth (middle),
and its false flags grow with sample size (right): bias, not noise. Splits 0–2; curve: split 0, 30 random subsets per size.
